licence: No licence stated — parish names and the counties they are filed under, read from the archive's own browse pages. These are facts about what the archive holds, not the records themselves, and the archive states no terms for them. The 1814-1892 colour scans were made by Ancestry and the archive says downloading more than a few needs Ancestry's written permission; no image is touched here.
note: One claim per collection per county, carrying the parishes it holds. soeg.rigsarkivet.dk, which is the search, answers `Disallow: /` and is not read; arkivalieronline, which is the viewer, answers `Disallow:` and is. Each page embeds its whole inventory as `var data` to feed its own combo boxes, so this is one request per collection rather than a crawl of every parish. NO RECORD COUNTS AND NO YEAR SPANS: the pages carry neither, and an invented number would be worth less than an absent one.
